tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Shruti Kaushik's research-backed go-to-market guides for B2B founders (LinkedIn, Reddit, AI search visibility, founder-led marketing and sales). Returns matching guides with their direct answer and URL.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get the full text (markdown) of one guide by slug, or one section of it by heading. Use after search_guides.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Find the closest published answers (from the FAQ sections of the guides and statistics pages) to a B2B go-to-market question. Each answer comes with its source URL.

tools.name: search_statistics
tools.description: Search a library of LinkedIn, Reddit, AI search, B2B buying and founder-led marketing statistics. Every figure includes the original publisher, date and source URL, plus the shrutikaushik.com page it is listed on.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List every published guide and every statistics topic page, with URLs.

tools.name: about_shruti_kaushik
tools.description: Who Shruti Kaushik is (LinkedIn and Reddit ghostwriter for B2B founders since 2015), what she offers, and how to book a call or get the free AI visibility check.

tools.name: check_linkedin_post
tools.description: Score a LinkedIn post draft (0 to 100) for the template patterns readers flag as AI-written, with each flagged pattern, the matched words and why it reads as generated. Runs the same checker as shrutikaushik.com/tools/linkedin-ai-slop-checker.

tools.name: founder_ai_visibility
tools.description: How Shruti Kaushik gets a founder and company named in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI answers: the method, the three service tiers, the monthly report, and how to get a free baseline check.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guides, search_statistics, list_topics, check_linkedin_post · Public sink: check_linkedin_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guides, search_statistics, list_topics, check_linkedin_post · Public sink: check_linkedin_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
